title: game-video:generate-scene-previews args
description: Agent-facing image generation for manifest scene entities. Read assetEntities.scenes from get-graph, then call during scenes.previewing or assets.scene. The tool registers scene_ref and updates assetCatalog entity current/history; it never writes asset production data into blueprint.json.

activityRevision.description: 可省略：幂等写与只读调用由 Host 从当前状态取当前活动修订号。只有需要跨活动世代做冲突检测时才显式携带。

expectedRevision.description: Current asset-manifest revision returned by get-graph.assetRevision.

idempotencyKey.description: 可省略：Host 按 (活动, 活动修订号, 目标) 生成稳定幂等键，重放不会重复出图。只有需要把多次调用显式归为同一批时才自己给。

sceneIds.description: Optional subset of node-referenced scene ids. Omit to generate every missing/stale referenced scene preview within the system limit.

mode.description: Kino image preset. multiview (default) = one 16:9 2560x1440 sheet with a full-width establishing panel on top and angleCount derived camera panels below; establishing = one 16:9 2560x1440 single-frame concept image. Prompt is derived from the manifest scene entity and the shared image schema.

angleCount.description: multiview only: how many derived camera panels sit below the establishing panel, taken in order from 主区域中景 / 局部特写 / 反向视角 / 入口·过渡区. Ignored when mode is establishing.

skipReady.description: Keep an already-ready preview whose source prompt hash and image shape still match the scene definition.
